acceptance_predicates.description: Every public command, adapter, monitor, runtime path, workload adapter, and build recipe maps all external executable/library/host dependencies to typed registry records.

The registry covers aider, codex, gemini, goose, mini-swe, opencode, opendesk, openhands, openjiuwen, qwen-code, development-only cli2key, perf, and bpftool, with provider APIs and procfs/cgroup correctly classified.
Linux, cgroup v2, user systemd, Bubblewrap, and kernel permission/BTF/PMU constraints are explicit host capabilities with honest remediation, never false downloadable tools.
ASB preflight reports missing supported IDs with exact install commands and host-only blockers before a command reaches a missing-tool runtime failure.
Mechanical CI rejects a new tool/workload/adapter/executable invocation without complete acquisition, dependency, preflight, and test metadata.

definition_of_done: Complete dependency inventory and positive/negative preflight matrix pass.
Independent review and exact-head/exact-main qualification pass.

outputs.description: Generated typed command/tool/workload/host dependency mapping and preflight.

gates.description: Generated inventory and controlled defects reject missing dependency declarations.
All initial IDs and host-only conditions have precise readiness/remediation evidence.
